Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.server

Interface AudioPlayer

public interface AudioPlayer
Feeds an AudioChannel with one frame every 20 ms on a background thread. Created by ServerVoiceApi.createAudioPlayer(net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.server.AudioChannel, java.util.function.Supplier<short[]>). It stops when the frame supplier returns null, when the channel is closed, or when stop() is called.
